summary.text: Vicky Steiner is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 37 since December 1, 2010 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Steiner earned a B.S. in mass communications from Minnesota State University-Moorhead, according to Ballotpedia.
Her professional experience includes working as executive director of the North Dakota Association of Oil and Gas Producing Counties and the North Dakota Coal Conversion Counties Association.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Finance and Taxation Committee and the House Government and Veterans Affairs Committee.
